labels.doc: Read the sheet in the Documentation

title.title: Exact nature of the work
title.how: Describe precisely the repair or maintenance to be carried out (e.g. "Replacement of the water heater safety unit"), not just a category ("Plumbing").
title.why: Mandatory mention on a quote (*devis*) for troubleshooting, repair or maintenance: the customer must know exactly what they are accepting.

urgent.title: Emergency call-out
urgent.how: Tick only if the customer themselves asked you to come to their home urgently. The quote is then limited to the parts and work strictly necessary to deal with the emergency.
urgent.why: In this case, the customer has no right of withdrawal (*rétractation*) for this work. Anything beyond the emergency remains subject to the fourteen-day period.

builder_works.title: Work covered by builders' guarantees
builder_works.how: Tick for construction work (a structure or inseparable equipment items). The quote then prints the legal guarantees, and sending it requires a valid ten-year liability (*décennale*) insurance certificate, attached automatically.
builder_works.why: This work engages your ten-year liability, which must be insured; the certificate must be attached to quotes and invoices.

client_siren.title: Customer's SIREN or SIRET
client_siren.how: Only for a business customer: 9 digits (SIREN) or 14 digits (SIRET), spaces accepted. Leave blank for a private individual.
client_siren.why: The business customer's identification number appears on the invoice. The right of withdrawal is still offered: it may benefit businesses with five employees or fewer, outside their main activity.

execution_terms.title: Date or time frame for performance
execution_terms.how: State a precise date or time frame (e.g. "Within 15 days of your agreement" or "On 12 November 2026"). Required to send the quote.
execution_terms.why: Before the contract is concluded, the professional must state the date or time frame within which they undertake to provide the service.

payment_terms.title: Payment terms
payment_terms.how: Specify when payment is due and the accepted means (bank transfer, cheque, cash…). Value taken from the settings. Required to send the quote.
payment_terms.why: Mandatory pre-contractual information. For a contract signed at the customer's home, no payment may be required before seven days.

time_counting.title: How estimated time is counted
time_counting.how: Explain how labour time is counted (e.g. "Time counted per quarter hour started").
time_counting.why: Information to be given to the customer before the contract is concluded, together with the hourly rate including VAT.

quote_price.title: Price of the quote
quote_price.how: Leave blank if the quote is free; otherwise, state its cost including VAT. Value taken from the settings.
quote_price.why: Before any commitment, the customer must know whether the quote is free or charged, and how much it costs.

debours_budget.title: Maximum budget of the disbursement mandate
debours_budget.how: Maximum amount the customer authorises you to spend in their name on parts. Beyond that, a new agreement is needed.
debours_budget.why: Disbursements (*débours*: parts bought in the name and on behalf of the customer, under their mandate, re-invoiced at exact cost) are outside your turnover and without your VAT, provided the conditions set by the tax authorities are met.

goods_received.title: Handover of the parts sold
goods_received.how: Enter the day the customer took possession of the resold parts, usually the day of installation. The end of the withdrawal period is then calculated.
goods_received.why: A quote including resold supplies is treated as a sale: the withdrawal period runs from taking possession of the goods, not from acceptance.

quote_vat_mode.title: VAT scheme
quote_vat_mode.how: Basic VAT exemption (*franchise en base*): you do not charge VAT (most often a micro-enterprise). VAT-registered: your quotes show VAT line by line. A quote already created keeps its scheme.
quote_vat_mode.why: Under the exemption, no VAT may appear on your quotes and invoices, and an exemption mention is mandatory. If VAT-registered, your VAT number must be given to the customer.

quote_vat_exemption.title: Exemption mention
quote_vat_exemption.how: « article 293 B » for the basic exemption; « article 293 B bis » for the exemption for supplies to another Member State. « Autre » (Other) only on your accountant's advice.
quote_vat_exemption.why: The text requires a mention matching the legal basis of the exemption, word for word, on invoices and documents serving as invoices.

quote_labour_rate.title: Hourly labour rate
quote_labour_rate.how: Enter your rate excluding VAT: it pre-fills the labour lines of quotes, and the showcase site publishes it including VAT (VAT added if you are registered).
quote_labour_rate.why: The customer must know the hourly labour rate including VAT before concluding, and this information must be easily accessible on your website.

quote_default_price.title: Cost of drawing up a quote
quote_default_price.how: Blank or 0: free quote. Otherwise, its price including VAT, published in the showcase site's prices and pre-filled on each new quote.
quote_default_price.why: Whether the quote is free or charged, and its cost, are part of the information to be given before the contract is concluded.

pricing_exclusions.title: What the prices do not include
pricing_exclusions.how: State what is not included in your displayed prices and will be needed (e.g. parts, priced on a quote).
pricing_exclusions.why: When an advertised price does not include an element essential to the service, this must be stated explicitly.

quote_payment_terms.title: Default payment terms
quote_payment_terms.how: When payment is due and accepted means; carried over to each new quote, editable quote by quote.
quote_payment_terms.why: Mandatory information before the contract is concluded.

quote_time_counting.title: How estimated time is counted
quote_time_counting.how: How labour time is counted (e.g. "per quarter hour started"). Shown on quotes and in the showcase site's prices.
quote_time_counting.why: Information to be given to the customer before the contract is concluded, together with the hourly rate including VAT.

quote_allow_supply.title: Resale of supplies
quote_allow_supply.how: Enable only if reselling parts is part of your declared activity. Otherwise, use parts bought in the customer's name (disbursements, *débours*).
quote_allow_supply.why: Reselling a part is a sale: the quote becomes a contract treated as a sale (withdrawal period running from delivery of the goods), and VAT on parts follows specific rules if you are VAT-registered.

quote_builder_guarantees.title: Builders' guarantees
quote_builder_guarantees.how: Tick if some of your work constitutes a structure or affects an inseparable equipment item (to be qualified with your insurer). Each quote then offers the corresponding box.
quote_builder_guarantees.why: This work engages your ten-year liability, which must be insured; the insurance certificate is attached to quotes and invoices.

legal_form.title: Legal form
legal_form.how: Individual enterprise (including micro-enterprise) or the form of your company.
legal_form.why: The status and legal form are communicated to the customer; they determine the « EI » mention or the form and share capital printed on your documents.

legal_ei_mention.title: « EI » designation
legal_ei_mention.how: « EI » or « Entrepreneur individuel » (individual entrepreneur), placed immediately next to your name.
legal_ei_mention.why: The individual entrepreneur uses a name incorporating their own name followed or preceded by these words, on all their business documents and correspondence.

legal_rm.title: Registration
legal_rm.how: Register in which you are entered: Registre national des entreprises (National Business Register, craft trades) or RCS and its town.
legal_rm.why: The RNE or RCS registration number is communicated to the customer and appears on your commercial documents.

legal_vat_number.title: Intra-EU VAT number
legal_vat_number.how: Only if you are VAT-registered. Leave blank under the basic exemption.
legal_vat_number.why: A VAT-registered professional communicates their individual VAT identification number.

legal_complaints.title: Complaints handling
legal_complaints.how: How the customer sends you a complaint (email, post) and within what time you reply.
legal_complaints.why: Complaints handling arrangements are part of the information to be given to the customer; a prior complaint is also a condition for going to the mediator.

legal_mediator.title: Consumer mediator
legal_mediator.how: Name, contact details and website address of the mediator you come under (often offered by your trade organisation).
legal_mediator.why: Every professional communicates the contact details of the mediator they come under, visibly on their website, and the mediator's website address.

legal_assurance.title: Professional insurance
legal_assurance.how: Insurer, its contact details and the geographical coverage of the policy.
legal_assurance.why: Information to be communicated to the customer when you have taken out professional liability insurance.
